_comment: Minimal fixture for the SAM4S8C boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit on the upstream sam4s8b Renode platform (PMC_SR flipflop + SAM4S_EEFC model satisfy the busy-wait loops + bootloader_request FRDY) and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the UART1 pty Renode exposes.
